# layout

Graph layout: positions only, with no rendering and no layout library. `layered` (Sugiyama) for directed graphs, `tidyTree`, `radialTree` and `dendrogram` for trees, `forceLayout`, `circularLayout` and `spectralLayout`, and `gridLayout`, `bipartiteLayout` and `latticeLayout`, all taking a `LayoutGraph` and returning a `GraphLayout`.

- function `dendrogram`: Lay out merges at their heights: `dendrogram(graph, heights)`. `src/layout/trees.ts:175` `mdml-render/layout`
- function `forceLayout`: A seeded force-directed layout: `forceLayout(graph, { seed: 1 })`. `src/layout/force.ts:58` `mdml-render/layout`
- function `layered`: Lay out a directed graph in layers: `layered({ nodes, edges })`. `src/layout/layered.ts:115` `mdml-render/layout`
- function `tidyTree`: Lay out a tree with parents over their children: `tidyTree(graph)`. `src/layout/trees.ts:91` `mdml-render/layout`

- structure `GraphLayout`: What every layout returns: node boxes, edge routes and group boxes. `src/layout/graph.ts:52` `mdml-render/layout`
- structure `LayoutGraph`: The graph every layout takes: nodes with sizes, edges and optional groups. `src/layout/graph.ts:26` `mdml-render/layout`
